copy.blurb:
A +13.7pp gap on the France side. Norway v France in FIFA World Cup 2026 is the match. The model has France stronger than the market does — that's the reason this fires as a Pick rather than a Pass.

Elo numbers going in: Norway 1760, France 2030. That's a 270-point lead for France — closer than a casual reader of the market price might assume. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. No host, home-ground, or altitude adjustments apply here; the prior reads straight from Elo.

Three-way split from the model: Norway to win at 15%, the draw at 14%, and France to win at 71%. Each number is a probability over the full range of plausible in-form, no-injury, ninety-minute scenarios — not a prediction of a scoreline.

On the same three-way, Polymarket: Norway to win at 18%, the draw at 24%, and France to win at 57%. On the France side specifically the market reads 57%, which prices out at American odds of −135. Compared against the model's 71%, that's the +13.7pp gap the Pick rests on.

The +3pp Pick threshold isn't on the point estimate, it's on the 5th-percentile from a 100-sample bootstrap of the Elo prior plus bonuses. On France, that haircut lands the model at 64%; the market is at 57%. Even on the conservative reading, the gap is +6.3pp. The point is selection, not a blanket call. Most matches the model and the market agree on. This is one of the ones where they don't, and the gap is on the France side specifically.

What would close this gap: confirmed team news that pulls the prior down on the side we like, a venue or weather change, or a tournament suspension landing before kickoff. With kickoff 31 days out, the refresh is weekly until we cross five days, then daily, then hourly inside the final day. A Pick this wide doesn't collapse on small news; a narrow one can flip to Pass on a single refresh. Either way, the engine republishes and the page reflects the latest read.
drivers: Confirmed XI, fitness news, and weather re-enter the prior closer to kickoff.
Bootstrap lower-bound on the France side still clears the Pick threshold.
